item.title: Perspectives: Kelly & Bailey James, Friends of the Helmerich Library - RSU.TV
item.description: Some people who live in Tulsa's 74127 Zip Code refer to it as "The forgotten Zip Code". The neighborhood west of downtown is often overlooked, and The Common Good is working to change that. Executive Director Stephen Pyle joined us to talk about how they serve that community, including partnering with Ascension St. John to create health equity and improve outcomes for those Tulsans.

item.title: Perspectives: Tim Landes, Writer, Photographer, Storyteller - RSU.TV
item.description: Journalist and photographer Tim Landes has a long career of covering stories in and around Tulsa, and is currently the Food, Arts, and Culture Editor at the Tulsa Flyer. We invited the Claremore native to join us for a conversation about his work, the Tulsa Local News Initiative and the importance of independent journalism.

item.title: Perspectives: Jorjana Marx, Midtown Elder Law of Tulsa, Oklahoma - RSU.TV
item.description: Oklahoma Senior Law attorney Jorjana Marx is presenting a series of fun and helpful classes on guardianship, Wills and Trusts, planning for the future, and asset protection taking place at the Will Rogers Library and the Claremore Senior Citizen's Center. She will be joined by Blaine Frizell of Fuller, Chlouber, and Frizell.
